Weak: S1.open_2, S1.age_a2 and S1.age_b2 are the same stem re-asked with the wrong option greyed out (retry is elimination). The age-cause probe recurs four times (S1.age_a, S1.age_b, S1.age_b2, S2.age_probe). S1.age_hint is close to giving the answer.

Good mechanism: S2.chain_probe wrong options each name a model, S2.chain_why gives the three-step chain with a device, S2.sym_probe and S2.vig_probe use the order as a filter. Weak: S2.end_probe distractors 'as ischaemia leads' and 'as the artery leads' are garbled and read as non-plausible; S2.age_probe repeats S1.age_a; S2.vig_probe option 'diffuse pain rules out appendicitis' is mapped to TR4 but is a symptom-pattern error.

Best drill of the module for the three signs: S3.case_t1 and S3.obt_t1 name the tempting model and nudge, S3.rov and S3.pos_t1 match the trap map. Weak: S3.contrast packs three manoeuvres and positions into one node; S3.alv has no Alvarado table before the probe and S3.alv_hint says 'go through MANTRELS letter by letter' with no list shown; S3.ttr_ok carries three look-alike lists; S3 runs about 35 nodes.

The trap map stem said 'in adults, most accurate'; the module stem drops both, and S4.a1_ok says 'Keep the old key too' with no exam rule. S4.a6 distractor 'unlikely band' is dominated. S4.c2 and S4.c2b teach the same rule back to back.
Fast lanes S1.open_ok, S2.pain_ok and S4.d1_ok are present and cover O1, O3 and O7 on skip. Included for completeness; not scored.

Wrong feedback names the model and gives the repair (S5.p2_w1, S5.p3_w1, S5.p4_w2) with claims. The cold check is not cold. S6.p1_t1 to S6.p1, S6.p3_t1 to S6.p3 and S6.p8_t1 to S6.p8 let the learner retry the same stem at once, so recovery is credited on a second attempt. S6.p5 option 'pain on sudden release' is mapped to TR3 but is a rebound error. O12 is first met at S6.p12 with no teaching node before it.

weakest_note: Worst first. S6 is lowest because its purpose (unaided check) is undermined by immediate retries and near-copies of earlier stems. S4 next because its exam key is ambiguous. S1, S2 and S3 tie at 3; ordered by repeated stems and garbled or dense nodes.
best_parts: S3.case_t1: names the tempting model ('internal rotation ... files easily next to this one'), nudges by movement, and sets a sure_note tied to the trap. The model for tempting-then-nudge feedback.
S5.p2_w1: contrast of the three antibiotics-first conditions with the appendicolith as the discriminator; claims K71 and K15 tie the repair to the note.
S2.chain_why: the lumen-to-gangrene chain in three steps, with the blocked-drain device placed after the claim, so the device is the memory aid and not the explanation.
flaws: Retry design, across S1.open_2, S1.age_a2, S1.age_b2, S3.alv2, S4.d1, S6.p1, S6.p3 and S6.p8: 'Try again' returns to the identical stem with the wrong option greyed out. Sims note this is elimination, not reasoning. The S6 'cold' probes allow the same retry, so 'fixed' is reached too easily (misconceived sim caveat). Fix: a fresh surface stem for each retry, and recovery credited only on a later, different-form probe.

Report accuracy (R9), sim/novice.report.json and sim/guesser.report.json: every trap is fell_open although the paths show correct answers on later probes (S6.p4, S6.p6, S6.p7, S6.p8, S6.p10, S6.p11 for novice). Hint count is 14 in the novice report but 2 opened in the path; wrong-answer hint-role nodes are counted as hints. Misconceived report: headline 'mixed' with 'solid base' despite 20 confident errors and 29 sure-wrong answers, text 'at least two', and card order 0 to 10 although the text promises 'confident errors first'. Strong report: cold_total 10 against 11 cards.

Key ambiguity and mis-cues: S4.a1 key is contestable (see segment S4); S4.a6 option 'A score of 7 puts appendicitis in the unlikely band' is dominated; S2.end_probe 'as ischaemia leads' and 'as the artery leads' are garbled; S6.p11 key cue as above; S6.p5 rebound option mapped to TR3. novice.reason: Headline 'weak' and all objectives 'gap' are partly right but not accurate. All 20 traps are fell_open, although the path reaches correct answers on later S6 probes for most of them (sim novice: FIXED for TR1 to TR12, TR14 to TR18, TR22, TR23, TR25). The hint count (14) counts wrong-answer nudge nodes, not hints opened (2). 'Confident errors first' does not apply (none). The advice to review cards and retake in a week is usable.

misconceived.reason: The key belief, overconfidence on 20 traps (29 sure-wrong), is under-reported. Headline 'mixed' and 'solid base with some real gaps' understate it; the text says 'at least two'; the 'confident errors first' order is not implemented (card_order 0 to 10). Per-trap texts are fell_recovered, which the sim says a same-stem retry makes easy to reach. The Sure-versus-guess advice is right and actionable.

strong.reason: Accurate: strong headline, all objectives secure, fast lane noted, Sure matched answers. Misses the S4.a1 key conflict and the repeated probes. Over-claims 'you chose the first test by patient' for O7, although S4.a1 was answered CT on an age-less stem. cold_total 10 against 11 cards is a count mismatch.

guesser.reason: Accurate on guessing (guess_right 5, 'Guessing on three or more answers you got right') and on hints (none opened). Trap statuses and objective gaps are built from first attempts, so fell_open for TR1, TR3 and TR4 overstate what was left, since the learner corrected on Try again. The next steps (two or three cards a sitting, answer before reading, retake in a week) are actionable.

report_check.overall: R9 is 2.67: the path diagnoses the belief well (the trap mapping works), but the report classifies recovery and calibration wrongly and in one case reverses the headline logic.

merge_ideas: Keep the 'Tempting: ... Nudge: ...' feedback (S3.case_t1 pattern), but open every wrong-answer hint-role node with a plain 'That is not right' (as S5.p2_w1 already implies), so a Sure learner knows a trap was hit.
Replace each same-stem retry (S1.open_2, S1.age_a2, S3.alv2, S6.p3, S6.p8) with a fresh stem that tests the same rule in a different surface form, as the trap map's 'retest' field asks.

Rewrite the S4.a1 stem to 'in adults, most accurate' as in the trap map, so the CT key is forced; S4.a1_ok then gives the exam rule for the age-less stem.
Merge S4.c2 and S4.c2b into one probe and cut S2.age_probe, the fourth age probe; use S1.age_a2 as the only retry for the age rule.
S5 template (qualifier stem, tempting-then-nudge feedback, numbered repair with claims) for S2.end_probe and S6.p11: this removes the garbled options and the key cue.

Report: count a hint only when a hint option is chosen; classify fell_recovered when a later probe on that trap is correct; sort card_order by confident errors as the text promises; compute cold_total on the same card set.
